id: title:christiaan-ph:disambiguate lifecycle only app version and build labels

review.posthog_relevance: Clarifies metadata descriptions for App build and App version properties, distinguishing lifecycle-specific transmission from standard event properties.
review.reason: The change consists of documentation and metadata updates in JSON configuration and corresponding Python implementation. It clarifies that App build and App version are only sent by mobile SDKs on app lifecycle events, while most events carry these properties differently. This is a narrow, localized maintenance and documentation improvement, not a substantive capability or systemic
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed documentation and metadata changes, but the actual impact on user behavior or system reliability is not demonstrated. No tier assignment is requested, only observations.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains 6 hunks across 2 files. P1.F1.* hunks are JSON configuration changes; P1.F2.* hunks are Python implementation changes. The JSON and Python changes are identical and clearly support each other, so this is a single change group. No other PRs are present, so no unrelated-PR uncertainty. No tier assignment is requested, only observations.
